hints.title: Binary Partitioning via Subarray Comparison
hints.text: The search space can be split into two halves of equal length.

hints.title: Subarray Comparison Evaluation
hints.text: compareSub returns 1 if left subarray sum is greater, -1 if right is greater, and 0 if equal.

hints.title: Odd Range Center Handling
hints.text: If the range length is odd, compare the left half to the right half excluding the midpoint; if sums match, midpoint is the target.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of array in reader
complexity.notes: Each comparison halves the search interval, requiring at most 20 queries for N <= 500,000.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing individual elements linearly uses O(N) queries, violating API limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Interval halving uses constant variables and logarithmic query bounds.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Binary search with careful odd/even subarray partition arithmetic.
